item.title: Solving problems is still the fun part of software development
item.description: I love the current state of software development. I care about solving people’s problems, and coding agents make more of the things I want to build feel worth attempting. There is a particular pleasure in getting rid of an awkward workaround that somebody has been putting up with for years. I don’t find that pleasure diminished by having written less of the code myself.
